# Agent Readiness HQ

> Agent Readiness HQ scores how well a business website can be read and understood by AI agents and automated systems, on a 0 to 100 scale across 7 machine-readability checks.

## About

Agent Readiness HQ is a Colorado-based, family-run business. It helps businesses make their websites easier for AI systems to access, understand, and accurately interpret.

## Services

- Free Readiness Scan: a free 7-check scan with a 0-100 score and top areas to review, run instantly on the website.
- AI Readiness DIY ($149, coming soon): full audit with prioritized fixes in plain English, copy-paste code snippets, a Custom AI Information Page built from verified business facts and ready to publish on the customer's own site, step-by-step publish instructions, and a developer handoff. Delivered in 5 business days.
- AI Readiness Implementation ($449, coming soon): everything in DIY, plus Agent Readiness HQ publishes the AI Information Page and implements the approved, platform-supported safe, high-priority fixes using temporary, minimum-permission access created by the customer. Includes a before-and-after report, done in 10 business days.
- AI Page Monitoring (optional add-on): $9.99/month or $99.99/year. Monthly checks keep the customer's AI Information Page current. Cancel anytime online.
